### Implemented Endpoints, Events & Rules
- `GET /blood/units`: Blood stock inventory reader. Supports filtering by ABO/Rh, component, source, status, and search query. Verified live on DEV as `demo.labtech` (200 OK).
- `POST /blood/units`: Unit intake from licensed blood sources or blood center. Enforces `rule:82db038331`: captures bag barcode, component, ABO/Rh, expiry, batch; the 'screened' checkbox is NEVER pre-ticked (unscreened units are refused). Only offered while `blood_transfusion` capability is Active (`rule:d10b19f697`).
- `GET /blood/units/{unit_id}`: Retrieves unit details, source information, donation number (for own center units), volume, and current reservation status.
- `POST /blood/units/{unit_id}/discard`: Wastage & discard modal with mandatory clinical reason (`rule:0e8d0a52ed`).
- `POST /blood/units/{unit_id}/return-to-source`: Returns uncrossmatched or recalled units to the supplying blood center with documentation (`rule:0e8d0a52ed`).
- `GET /blood/requests`: Reads clinical blood worklist with status filtering (`Open`, `Fulfilled`, `Cancelled`, `All`). Priority emergency sorting puts emergency orders at top (`rule:cdfdb93c8e`). Verified live on DEV as `demo.labtech` (200 OK).
- `GET /blood/requests/{request_id}`: Fetches request details including transfusion consent status, urgency, indication, uncrossmatched clinical authorization note, compatibility tests, and issued units.
- `POST /blood/requests/{request_id}/crossmatches`: Serological crossmatch testing. Selects compatible stock unit of requested component; compatibility marks unit reserved (`rule:7378206488`). Offered during Active or Retiring service (`rule:6b0e7c1748`).
- `POST /blood/requests/{request_id}/issue`: Bedside issue with dual sign-off (`rule:7378206488`). The collecting nurse or doctor enters their staff credentials (`collector_username`, `collector_password`), enforcing `STEP_UP_REQUIRED` and `ADMINISTRATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED`. Emergency issues without test require doctor's uncrossmatched clinical note (`BLOOD_CROSSMATCH_REQUIRED`). Offered during Active or Retiring service (`rule:9f01252b75`).
- `POST /blood/requests/{request_id}/close`: Fulfills or closes blood request when requirements are met.
- `POST /blood/transfusions/{transfusion_id}/return`: 30-minute return window sign-off (`rule:0e8d0a52ed`). If returned within 30 minutes with cold chain intact, unit is returned to stock (`fit_for_use: true`); otherwise marked `NotGiven` with reason and discarded.
- `GET /blood/storage-checks`: Cold chain storage log with date range filtering. Verified live on DEV as `demo.labtech` (200 OK).
- `POST /blood/storage-checks`: Temperature checks for Blood Refrigerator (+2°C to +6°C), Plasma Freezer (<=-25°C), Platelet Agitator/Incubator (+20°C to +24°C) (`rule:970c05860c`). Readings out of safe limits mandate documented `action_taken` (`STORAGE_CHECK_ACTION_REQUIRED`).
- `GET /blood/storage-checks/pdf`: Official A4 cold chain temperature audit log PDF download.
- `GET /blood/sources`: Approved licensed blood sources dropdown for unit intake. Verified live on DEV as `demo.labtech` (200 OK, returning 2 sources).
- `ev:blood.request.created`: Live reactive listener instantly updates the blood request worklist without polling.
- `ev:blood.consent.withdrawn`: Alerts technician if consent is revoked while blood is in preparation.
- `ev:blood.storage.out_of_range`: Broadcasts real-time cold chain alert badge across bank UI.
- `ev:blood.reaction.reported`: Displays immediate adverse transfusion reaction warning on worklist.
- `ev:blood_center.component.released`: Automatically refreshes stock inventory when own center units are released.
- `rule:cdfdb93c8e`: FEFO sorting puts soonest expiring units first. Expired units flagged in bold red with direct 'Discard' action. Emergency orders prioritized first in worklist.

# Screen 157: badge_station_kiosk (Badge Station Kiosk)

## 1. Summary of Implementation
- Implemented full-screen unattended Badge Station Kiosk (`badge_station_kiosk`, Workspace `badge_station`, Position 157, 45 points).
- Generated typed pure API client in `src/generated/badge_station_kiosk.ts` covering both contract endpoints:
  - `GET /badge-stations/me`: Kiosk station setup retrieving station profile, location, device type, action type, debounce seconds, and dirty beds list (station-authenticated with `X-Station-Key`, no user login).
  - `POST /badge-stations/scans`: Post badge presentation with `station_id`, `badge_code`, optional `bed_code`, client `scanned_at` timestamp, and `gateway_event_id` for idempotent processing.
- Realtime Event Listeners & Emitted Events:
  - `ev:bed.state_changed`: Emitted when bed sanitization scan completes and unlocks bed.
  - `ev:ops.badge.scan`: Emitted on door or access telemetry scans.
- Statutory Rules & Domain Policies in `src/badge-station-kiosk-policy.ts`:
  - `rule:f98f89a7b6`: Configure once with station ID and key (`X-Station-Key`). The station key is masked (`••••••••`) and never displayed in cleartext on the public-facing kiosk screen.
  - `rule:141cb8255f`: High-speed USB barcode scanner capture keeps an invisible input focused, capturing scanned digits and Enter keystrokes automatically without staff login or keyboard use.
  - `rule:b2f4ebb077`: Dual-scan bed cleaning workflow (`needs_bed_code: true`). Collects two scans (bed sticker `HMS-BED-…` and staff badge) in either order within 60 seconds with live countdown timer, and posts them together.
  - `rule:2554916922`: Big high-contrast green/red flash result modal with the outcome in bilingual words and synthesized Web Audio chime/buzz tones; automatically returns to ready state after 3 seconds.
  - `rule:438ca845ec`: Resilient offline queue buffering scans with unique `gateway_event_id` in localStorage during network disconnects, resending them idempotently when connectivity resumes.
  - Debounce enforcement preventing accidental double-scanning of the same badge within `debounce_seconds`.
  - Bilingual error dictionary mapping statutory error codes (`BADGE_STATION_UNKNOWN`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `OFFLINE_QUEUED`, `SCAN_TIMEOUT`, `DEBOUNCE_WAIT`).
- UI Architecture & Contextual Help:
  - Kiosk view in `src/screens/BadgeStationKiosk.tsx` with high-contrast UI, offline indicator, dual-scan progress cards, on-screen simulator input for hardware-free testing, dirty beds quick action drawer, operator setup drawer, and offline queue drawer.

The system automatically designates the lowest filled line in Part I as the underlying cause. Part II records other significant contributory conditions.
  - Diagnostic suggestion chips (`rule:9e98e4c3ec`): surfaces active conditions from previous charts as clickable chips to assign to cause lines; never silently populates.

Once certified, editing is locked permanently and corrections must be appended (`POST /deaths/{id}/corrections`) with mandatory factual justification (min 3 chars).
